programme.title: Voyage to the Planet of Prehistoric Women
programme.desc: 1968. Sci-fi. Director: Peter Bogdanovich. Stars Mamie Van Doren & Mary Marr. When a group of astronauts land on Venus they are surprised to find dangerous creatures and beautiful women. [S]

programme.title: The Purple Monster Strikes
programme.desc: 1945. The Living Dead. A physician has created an oxygen device that will revolutionize the treatment of lung diseases. Of course, this is just the sort of thing that the Purple Monster needs!

programme.title: Lord Tramp
programme.desc: 1977. Comedy. Southern TV Series. A tramp inherits a title, country house and fortune. But how will it affect him? Starring Hugh Lloyd, Joan Sims, George Moon and Alfie Bass (S1, E05)

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Set a Murderer. 1954. Stars Honor Blackman, Martin Boddey, Clifford Evans. Two successful businessmen have a monopoly of the market in their particular field but suddenly a new competitor arrives. [S]

programme.title: Danger UXB
programme.desc: The Silver Lining. 1979 Stars Anthony Andrews, Judy Geeson & Geraldine Gardner. The men of 347 section have their skills put to the test as they attempt to defuse a bomb in a Soho nightclub.

programme.title: Jackpot (1960)
programme.desc: 1960. Drama. Director Montgomery Tully. Stars William Hartnell, Betty McDowall & Eddie Byrne. An ex-convict learns that his wife is not willing to return to him. A rare screening of a 'lost' film. [S]

programme.title: Runaround
programme.desc: 1980. Presented by Mike Reid. Prizes include a pocket camera & a cassette radio player. This episode features a look at the world's largest tricycle and Jona Lewie performs.

programme.title: Legend of the Hidden City
programme.desc: 1997. Stars Brendan Pollecutt, Fezile Mpela & Robert Finlayson. Adjusting to modern life is challenging for the young couple as they struggle to remember their time in the jungle.

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: The Missing Princess.1957. Stars William Russell, Cyril Smith & Ronald Leigh-Hunt. A King's sister is taken hostage when he breaks a treaty with a tribe of women. [S]

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Foggiest Notion. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward, Yvonne Craig & Glynis Johns. Lord Ffogg & Lady Peasoup plan to steal clothing material so they can control the fashion world of Londinium. [S]

programme.title: Hawkeye & the Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: The Coward. 1957. Director: Sam Newfield. Stars John Hart, Lon Chaney Jr & Jonathan White. Tom and his father are attacked by Hurons. Tom runs away in fear leaving his wounded father behind. [S]

programme.title: Captain Scarlet and the Mysterons
programme.desc: Seek and Destroy. 1968. Stars Jeremy Wilkin, Sylvia Anderson, Donald Gray. When the Mysterons threaten to kill one of the Angels, Scarlet and Blue are sent to Paris to ensure Destiny is kept safe. [S]

programme.title: Champion The Wonderhorse
programme.desc: Salted Ground. 1955. Stars Champion, Barry Curtis, & Jim Bannon. Can a gullible store owner be helped by Ricky and Sandy when it looks like he is about to be conned? [S]

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Hurricane. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Derek Sydney & Ewen Solon. As New Providence recovers from a hurricane, word spreads that a treasure ship has sunk nearby. Tempest decides to seek the gold. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Isabella. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Zena Walker, Helen Cherry & Donald Pleasence. Princess Avice summons Robin for help after discovering her husband is planning to marry a French princess. [S]

programme.title: Bela Lugosi Meets a Brooklyn Gorilla
programme.desc: 1952. Comedy. Directed by William Beaudine. Stars Bela Lugosi, Duke Mitchell & Sammy Petrillo. Two entertainers parachute into the jungle on an island, where they meet a mad scientist. [S]

programme.title: Busy Bodies
programme.desc: 1933. Comedy. Directed by Lloyd French. Stars Stan Laurel and Oliver Hardy. Stan & Ollie do battle with inanimate objects & their co-workers during a routine work day at the saw mill. [S]

programme.title: Jigsaw
programme.desc: 1962. Directed by Val Guest and starring Jack Warner. A woman is murdered and it's up to Detective Fellows to sift through the clues and solve the 'Jigsaw'. Great shots of Brighton in the 60s. [S]

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: The Hunters. 1961. Stars Peter Graves, Bettina Welch & Phillip Ross. A farmer is speared by Aboriginals for interrupting a sacred ceremony, Cobb and a tracker go in search of the wounded farmer. [S]

programme.title: Mr Denning Drives North
programme.desc: 1951. Crime. Director: Anthony Kimmins. Stars John Mills, Phyllis Calvert & Eileen Moore. A British aircraft engineer accidentally kills his daughter's boyfriend and then tries to it cover up... [S]

programme.title: Dick Turpin
programme.desc: Swiftnick. 1979. Stars Richard O'Sullivan, Christopher Benjamin & David Daker. Mary Smith's son attempts to pay off her debts by taking up the guise of the infamous highwayman Dick Turpin. [S]

programme.title: Maigret

programme.title: The Duchess of Duke Street
programme.desc: A Matter of Honour. 1976. Stars Gemma Jones, Christopher Cazenove & Michael Culver. Charlie is shocked to find that one of his best friends, Lord Elleston, arranged for his horse to lose at Ascot. [S]

programme.title: Curse of Frankenstein

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Tam Turbulence. Sheldon won't tell anyone why he's never mentioned his childhood friend Tam. Bernadette and Penny take out Raj's fiancée to get the skinny on her. S12, Ep4

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Planetarium Collision. Amy doesn't have time to work on a project, so Sheldon goes to great lengths to ensure she can work with him, even if it means sabotaging her career. S12, Ep5

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Imitation Perturbation. When Howard dresses up as Sheldon for Halloween, Sheldon seeks retaliation. Leonard is shocked that Penny doesn't remember their first kiss. S12, Ep6

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Grant Allocation Derivation. Leonard is caught in a tough spot when he's responsible for distributing extra grant money. Bernadette turns the backyard playhouse into a hideaway. S12, Ep7

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Consummation Deviation. Sheldon tries to bond with Amy's father, but Howard lures Mr. Fowler away with magic tricks. Raj and Anu try to get physical for the first time. S12, Ep8

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Citation Negation. Sheldon and Amy are devastated learning that Super Asymmetry has been discovered and disproven. Bernadette asks Denise to help her win a videogame. S12, Ep9

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The VCR Illumination. A VHS tape inspires Sheldon to not give up on his and Amy's theory. Bernadette turns into a pageant mom over Howard's Magic Castle audition. S12, Ep10

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Paintball Scattering. Penny and Leonard organise a paintball game that results in mayhem. Raj catches Anu with her ex, and Stuart doesn't want to move in with Denise. S12, Ep11

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Propagation Proposition. Penny's ex, Zack, and his wife want a baby, but when Zack is infertile, they ask Leonard to help. Raj attempts to mend things with his ex-fiancée. S12, Ep12

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Confirmation Polarization. Sheldon and Amy's theory is proven by two physicists, who then try to kick Amy off the Nobel nomination. Bernadette has a big success at work. S12, Ep13

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Meteorite Manifestation. Sheldon helps Bernadette and Howard navigate bureaucratic paperwork. Leonard is disappointed when his friends exclude him from a scientific project. S12, Ep14

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Donation Oscillation. Penny tries to seduce an abstaining Leonard to ruin his 'donation' for her ex-boyfriend and his wife. Raj's cancelled bachelor party takes a turn. S12, Ep15

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The D & D Vortex. The gang finds out Wil Wheaton hosts a celebrity Dungeons and Dragons game. Deception and betrayal are the path to make it to the one open seat. S12, Ep16

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Conference Valuation. While Bernadette is away and Howard is in charge of the kids, Sheldon finds a book on experimenting on kids. The guys plus Amy make a day of it. S12, Ep17

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Laureate Accumulation. Pemberton and Campbell charm America, so Sheldon and Amy bring Nobel laureates Kip Thorne, George Smoot and Frances Arnold to their side. S12, Ep18

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Inspiration Deprivation. Amy has a meltdown due to the pressure associated with winning a Nobel Prize. Raj and Howard try to relive the good old days. S12, Ep19

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Decision Reverberation. Raj is worried people won't take him seriously in his own field after publishing a paper that suggests he may have discovered alien life. S12, Ep20

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Plagiarism Schism. Kripke has proof that Dr. Pemberton plagiarized his thesis, and Sheldon and Amy aren't sure whether they should turn him in or not. S12, Ep21

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Maternal Conclusion. Leonard is surprised when Beverly is kind to him on a visit, until he finds out the real reason she's there. Denise and Stuart overstay their welcome. S12, Ep22

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: California Bumpin'. Brent has a tricep bump that could be intertwined in his muscle. Plus, Jeb avoids the beach because of the massive number of bumps all over his body. S5, Ep19

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Nevus And Bumphead. Jacqueline's shoulder growth makes it difficult to do fire spinning, her favourite hobby. And the mysterious bump on James' cheek loves to bleed. S5, Ep2
